definitions.explanation: To prepare tea, especially matcha, by whisking the powdered tea with hot water using a bamboo whisk. A term associated with tea ceremony and traditional tea preparation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{点|た}てる。
⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{点|た}てて⟦くださった→くださる：01305_kudasaru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher made tea for us.

examples.japanese: ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{稽古|けいこ}→稽古：00210_keiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{点|た}てた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{泡|あわ}→泡：02175_awa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦{立|た}たなかった→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: I made tea by myself for the first time in tea ceremony practice, but I couldn't get a good froth.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). No intransitive pair.

USAGE:
This verb is specific to preparing tea, especially ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧. It is not used for brewing other beverages. For making regular tea (⟦{煎茶|せんちゃ}→煎茶：13407_sencha⟧ etc.), use ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ or ⟦{淹|い}れる→淹れる：13297_ireru⟧ instead.

The polite form ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{点|た}てる is very common, reflecting the formality associated with ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧ (tea ceremony).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{点|た}てる: to make matcha
- ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{点|た}てる: to make tea (polite)
- {薄茶|うすちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{点|た}てる: to make thin tea
- {濃茶|こいちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{点|た}てる: to make thick tea
